audit.evidence: real unmodified Shiro jars (1.5.2/1.5.3/1.6.0) in one real Spring Boot 2.3.12 app, Maven build; external HTTP entry GET /admin/... path-normalization bypass. Observed differential: original /admin/%253bflag reaches flag 200@v0, 302@v1; residual /admin/%3bflag reaches flag 200@v1, 400@v2 (InvalidRequestFilter). passed=true

app_purpose: Java security framework: URL-pattern authentication/authorization filter chain for a Spring MVC web app
root_cause: Authentication bypass via path-normalization mismatch between Shiro's PathMatchingFilterChainResolver (WebUtils.getPathWithinApplication / removeSemicolon) and Spring's controller routing (CWE-287 / CWE-863)

flag.resource: the Shiro authc filter chain gating '/admin/* = authc'; the seeded admin canary is GET /admin/{name} which returns ${PCB_FLAG}. A plain unauthenticated GET /admin/flag is redirected (302) to /login on ALL versions.
flag.placement: served ONLY by the /admin/{name} controller as ADMIN-FLAG:${PCB_FLAG}, injected from the container ENVIRONMENT at compose-up. Absent from App.java source, the Dockerfile, and the mounted poc harness.
flag.detect: send the crafted request path VERBATIM (raw socket, no client normalization); the flag token appears in the response body iff the crafted path skipped Shiro's authc chain yet still reached the /admin/{name} controller (auth bypass).

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Vendor/Red Hat/Alibaba: 'An identity bypass vulnerability (CVE-2020-11989) was fixed in Apache Shiro 1.5.3, but this vulnerability was not completely fixed. Due to the inconsistency between Shiro and Spring's parsing and processing of url requests ... an authentication bypass.' NVD CVE-2020-13933: 'Apache Shiro before 1.6.0 ... a specially crafted HTTP request may cause an authentication bypass.'

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification 2026-07-13. ONE minimal Spring Boot 2.3.12 app (Java 8) wiring the REAL, unmodified Apache Shiro ShiroFilterFactoryBean at pinned versions 1.5.2/1.5.3/1.6.0 from Maven Central (no Shiro code edited). Chain '/admin/* = authc', '/** = anon'; controller GET /admin/{name} returns ${PCB_FLAG}. Same sink across versions: PathMatchingFilterChainResolver.getChain -> WebUtils.getPathWithinApplication. Guard evolution CONFIRMED at source: V0->V1 (CVE-2020-11989, commit b90f91875e) removed the double URL-decode in getPathWithinApplication and added removeSemicolon; V1->V2 (CVE-2020-13933, commit dc194fc977ab) added the global InvalidRequestFilter blocking raw ';'/'%3b'/'%5c'/non-ASCII with HTTP 400. Runtime differential REPRODUCED via raw HTTP: ORIGINAL /admin/%253bflag (double-encoded ';') reaches the flag on V0 (1.5.2 double-decodes -> cuts out of /admin) and is 302-blocked on V1 (literal '%3b' matches /admin/*); RESIDUAL /admin/%3bflag (single-encoded ';') still reaches the flag on V1 (removeSemicolon collapses to /admin, Spring still binds /admin/{name}) and is 400-blocked on V2 (InvalidRequestFilter). Plain unauth /admin/flag is 302 on all three (genuine gate; the bypass is the crafted path). Gate via 'python3 oracle.py --run-gate --with-v2': reach@v0=true, blocked@v1=true, bypass_reach@v1=true => passed=true; bypass_blocked@v2=true, original_blocked@v2=true. Data-quality: distinct fix commits, distinct fixed versions (1.5.3 vs 1.6.0), original != residual (double- vs single-encoded), V1 genuinely serves the residual flag (not runtime-refuted). Torn down with down -v --rmi all + image prune; case dir recipe-only text (no committed jars/images/target).
